# `auth`

Authentication and credentials

**Usage:** `nub auth <COMMAND>`

## Subcommands

- [login](#login)
- [logout](#logout)
- [status](#status)
- [setup-git](#setup-git)
- [git-credential](#git-credential)

## `login`

Log in to a host

**Usage:** `nub auth login [OPTIONS]`

### Options

| Option | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--with-token` |  | Read a personal access token from stdin instead of the browser flow |
| `--git-host <GIT_HOST>` |  | Override the git host to register for the credential helper |

## `logout`

Remove stored credentials for the host

**Usage:** `nub auth logout`

## `status`

Show the current authentication status

**Usage:** `nub auth status`

## `setup-git`

Register `nub` as a git credential helper

**Usage:** `nub auth setup-git`

## `git-credential`

Git credential protocol entry point (invoked by git, not by users)

**Usage:** `nub auth git-credential <OPERATION>`

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `<OPERATION>` | Protocol operation requested by git [possible values: get, store, erase] |
